Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - Aug 09, 2011
Description: Introduction of calendar-based forward guidance: ‘exceptionally low levels for the federal funds rate at least through mid-2013.’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - Dec 16, 2008
Description: ZLB is reached and introduction of clear forward guidance phrase: ‘exceptionally low levels of the federal funds rate for some time.’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - July 06, 1995
Description: First explicit mention of numerical target for federal funds rate. Also, interest rate cut: ‘...inflationary pressures have receded enough to accommodate a modest adjustment in monetary conditions.’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - Nov 17, 1998
Description: Third cut in a row and signal that there may not be further cuts: ‘financial conditions can reasonably be expected to be consistent with fostering sustained economic expansion’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - May 17, 1994
Description: Fed funds target rate increased by 50 bps to ‘...substantially remove the degree of monetary accommodation which prevailed throughout 1993.’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - Nov 25, 2008
Description: TALF announcement: ‘...increase credit availability and support economic activity by facilitating more renewed issuance of consumer and small business ABS at more normal interest rate spreads.’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - Oct 15, 1998
Description: FOMC stated that ‘further easing of the stance of monetary policy was judged to be warranted to sustain economic growth’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - Mar 18, 2009
Description: Change in language about low rates to ‘for an extended period’ from previous statement which said ‘for some time’

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - June 30, 2004
Description: First increase in four years and guidance about future rate increases.

Meeting date: Top-ten declines in monetary policy uncertainty - Oct 29, 2008
Description: Fed funds target rate cut by 50 bps. Confirmation that the FOMC ‘...will act as needed to promote sustainable economic growth and price stability.’

Meeting date: Top-five increases in monetary policy uncertainty - Oct 08, 2008
Description: Announcement after unscheduled meeting of concerted actions by central banks around the world

Meeting date: Top-five increases in monetary policy uncertainty - Jan 28, 2004
Description: Change in language to ‘...can be patient in removing its policy accommodation’ and removal of ‘considerable period’ language

Meeting date: Top-five increases in monetary policy uncertainty - Apr 18, 1994
Description: Unscheduled conference call: ‘increase slightly the degree of pressure on reserve positions. This action is expected to be associated with a small increase in short-term money market interest rates.’

Meeting date: Top-five increases in monetary policy uncertainty - Feb 04, 1994
Description: First rate hike in years in line with the FOMC decision ‘...to move toward a less accommodative stance in monetary policy ...’

Meeting date: Top-five increases in monetary policy uncertainty - Mar 28, 1995
Description: The FOMC indicated ‘asymmetric directive also would provide a clear signal of the Committee’s intention to resist higher inflation.’
